title: Evolution Companions — Complete 8-Plush Collector Set
descriptionHtml:
Eight little companions. One complete collection.

Bring home every colorful hood, stitched smile and tiny pair of brown paws. Pick your first favorite, then find a spot for the whole lineup.

Your complete set

  • Eight separate plushes, one of every pictured design
  • Approximately 8 × 7 × 6 inches each
  • Free U.S. shipping; delivery typically takes 5–7 business days

Care

Spot clean gently and air dry. Not suitable for children under 3 years old.

Delivery and returns

Your set may arrive separately from other items in your order. If your order is lost in transit, damaged, defective, incorrect or materially different from its description, contact us with your order number and available photos. View delivery and returns.
